summary: Tessera Defense & Homeland Security Inc. filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026 disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Tessera Israel, entered an Option Agreement with X S.E. Security and Defense Ltd. for the right to purchase X SE's 51% fully diluted stake in Israeli aerostat developer RT LTA Systems Ltd. Tessera Israel paid $1,000,000 option consideration, creditable against purchase price and refundable if unexercised. The 90-day option is subject to satisfactory due diligence, board approvals, RT shareholder consents, Israeli Ministry of Defense approval and Israel Innovation Authority review. Watch for exercise timing, regulatory clearances, and refund mechanics.
